about: P1 R1c form library: HER SHOULDERS (OURS, designed; rule "field"). The milestone judge (in game, close-up camera): "a tube-like neck flaring into shoulders as wide as the hips, with deltoids that look like shoulder pads". With torso.json's shoulder_span (the span itself, a skeletal width: it moves the arm joints), these set the shoulder's soft forms: the trapezius' rise up the side of the neck (the neck flows into the shoulder line) and the deltoid cap. Masks on the reference V0 (glTF m, x her left +, y up, z front +; the A-pose rest, the shrug reference: its shoulder top at y 1.60-1.62 between 5 and 13 cm out).

trap_rise.why: the trapezius carried up the side of the neck: 16 mm up at v = 1, full 9.5-11.5 cm out (5 mm at 7 cm, 13 mm at 13 cm, 0 by 16.5 cm), the back and top only (z under -1 cm, easing over 6 cm), the back below the shoulder top easing over 8 cm, the ring and the neck column within 1 cm of it held (C2): trap_drop's 26 mm cut at 5.5-8.5 cm left a level yoke from 9 to 17 cm out (the shoulder top 71-90 mm under the chin) that met the neck column in a corner (a tube on a flat yoke); this lifts the yoke's inner half into one slope from the neck to the acromion (the shoulder top 7 -> 17 cm: about -40 -> -90 mm). Off the back midline: the nape (and skeleton.cervical_joint) does not move.

moves.why: P1 R1c round 7: the Look's silhouette step where trap_rise's fade meets the deltoid: hanging, the line went concave at 15-17 cm out (+8 /m); filled so it stays convex from 12.5 cm to the deltoid (rule shoulder_line_concave_per_m); height only, no width

deltoid_cap.why: the deltoid cap cut in: 11 mm along the inward normal at v = 1 at the cap's middle (V0 (23.2, 152.8, -3.8) cm: the outer top of the shoulder over the humeral head), a C2 bell easing to 0 over 7.5 cm sideways and up, 9 cm front to back (the front, outer and back heads together). Her cap stood 64 mm off the humerus axis over a 43-47 mm upper arm (a 17-20 mm ball: "shoulder pads"); this takes about 20% off the cap's radius and blends it into the arm and the trapezius as one slope. Soft (build_topo.bone_body): soft tissue, the joints do not move. P1 R1c round 3: its relax evens the one stretched quad a side where the cap's back meets trap_rise (V0 (14.3, 160.2, -6.7) cm, aspect 4.09: a 3 mm edge against a 12 mm one), shape kept (tangential). trap_rise is now soft too (no joint follows it).
